messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Customers worry they cannot switch payment providers without disruption. This restricts their ability to adopt better or more cost-effective solutions.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "3d6f7b4a-ed9c-52d3-97a0-2d967a79bcf2",
   "similarity": 0.043,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"3d6f7b4a-ed9c-52d3-97a0-2d967a79bcf2\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Policyholder milestone notifications\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Policyholder milestone notifications\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Keelwater will automatically notify policyholders when they reach key milestones in their claims process, such as document submission completion, adjuster assignment, or payout approval, helping them stay informed without needing to check status manually.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Keelwater will automatically notify policyholders when they reach key milestones in their claims process, such as document submi"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4130",
   "similarity": 0.038,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now provides a clearer, more detailed payment history view, helping users track transactions, refunds, and adjustments with improved timestamps and categorization for faster reconciliation.\", \"id\": 4130, \"name\": \"Payment history improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4131",
   "similarity": 0.019,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater's workspace administration feature allows users to manage permissions, configure settings, and organize teams within their claims environment — all through a centralized, intuitive dashboard.\", \"id\": 4131, \"name\": \"Workspace administration\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4128",
   "similarity": 0.019,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now allows users to filter claims by date range, status, and claim type, making it easier to locate specific claims without scrolling through unrelated entries.\", \"id\": 4128, \"name\": \"Claim search refinements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4129",
   "similarity": 0.019,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The core problem — customers worrying they cannot switch payment providers without disruption — does not match any shipped story. The closest similar items, 'Payment history improvements' (#4130), 'Workspace administration' (#4131), 'Claim search refinements' (#4128), and 'Supplier contact details' (#4129), are all completed but address unrelated problems, and the notion page covers policyholder milestone notifications. No roadmap item covers provider switching either. The problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
